text.description_html:
Fusion P-13-E2-ORB, Oil Rubbed Bronze Hammered Knob with Blacksmith Rose

With beautiful texture to add a point of interest, the Fusion made Hammered Half Knob is the perfect accompaniment to any traditionally styled home. The half-round knob paired with the blacksmith rose is an interesting combination of shapes that is not only aesthetically pleasing to the eye, but is easily transferred from the southwestern design for which this knob and rosette pair was made to more modern homes as well. Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking. It will fit 1-1/4 inch to 2 inch thick doors and with backset of 2-3/8 inches. Finished in Oil Rubbed Bronze.

Features of the Fusion Oil Rubbed Bronze Hammered Passage Knob Set:

  • Solid Brass Construction
  • Cycle Tested to ANSI Standards
  • Exclusive Fusion knob spring assembly for lifetime performance
  • Reversible Latchbolt in matching/coordinating finish
  • Easy assembly with alignment block and rose posts

Specifications for Fusion Oil Rubbed Bronze Hammered Passage Knob Set:

  • Knob Diameter: 2-1/4"
  • Knob Projection: 2-1/8"
  • Rose Height: 4"
  • Rose Width: 2-3/4"
  • Rose Projection: 1/2"
  • Door Thickness: 1-1/4" to 2"
  • Backsets: 2-3/8"
  • Material: Solid Brass
  • Standard Latch Rotation is 40 Degrees.
  • Square corner latches and strike plates
  • Function: Passage (Hall or Closet): For doors that don't need locking.
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze

** Clearance Priced, limited quantities available.

Only (1) Left.
